g.text: Each panel states its denominator; these are not percentages of a common oral dose.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536779

g.text: Essentially all eliminated unchanged by the kidney; route summary, not an oral recovery measurement.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536779

g.text: About 90% recovered via the renal route in 24 hours; unchanged drug.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536779

g.text: 50–70% recovered unchanged in urine after an IV dose in healthy volunteers.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #17324d

g.text: Gabapentin and metformin are incompletely absorbed: do not interpret these as 100% or 90% of a swallowed dose.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536779
